remarks: Welcome to Woodland Terrace, a highly sought-after townhouse community offering exceptional convenience in the heart of Stamford. This 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse is the perfect opportunity for buyers looking to customize, renovate, and build equity. The main level features a spacious open-concept living and dining area, a functional kitchen layout, and a convenient half bath. Sliding doors lead to a private balcony ideal for relaxing or entertaining outdoors. Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms and a full bathroom, ready for your personal updates and design vision. With the right improvements, this home offers strong upside potential for both homeowners and investors. Additional highlights include an attached one-car garage with interior access, in-unit laundry area, and plenty of guest parking. Ideally located just minutes from shopping, dining, the Merritt Parkway, and the Springdale train station, this home provides easy access for commuters while maintaining a peaceful community setting!
